source.question: Which wells need attention right now, and why? Forecast the next 12 months of oil for the well that needs it most.

note: Reviewed Oct 29, fair: 55% and 34% between periods called steps (21% and 8% across), 'stayed within its design limits' while injection passed its capacity, undeclared 83%, 58%, 1.08. The '60-day' window was a false rejection, now free.

submission.summary: F-12 needs attention most: its downhole pressure gauge is dead and water is now about 69% of its liquids after a 55% oil-rate drop, with a recent bridge plug failing to cut water. F-14 also shows rising water but is less urgent. The platform is within design limits and voidage replacement is near 1. For F-12 the central estimate for the next 12 months is about 375,000 Sm3, range 316,000 to 1.11 million, but the fit is poor so uncertainty is high.

findings.claim: F-12 needs attention most: oil rate is 1 551 Sm3/d at 69% water cut with a dead downhole gauge since 2010-10-12.
findings.detail: Field screen as of 2010-12-31, 90-day window: oil_rate 1551 Sm3/d, water_cut 0.6939, uptime 0.9846, level caution. Gauge reads 0 on 81 days 2010-10-12 to 2010-12-31 while flowing 80 days, 123,258 Sm3 oil, last good 253.9 bar on 2010-10-11. Water cut regime shift around 2010-02-28: weekly mean 0.0323 -> 0.57; crossed 0.5 on 2010-06-04, 28 months after first oil.

findings.claim: F-12's oil rate dropped 55% around 2010-05-02, weekly mean 4 207 to 1 888 Sm3/d, with choke cut from 83% to 58% at the same time.
findings.detail: Regime change oil_rate 2010-05-02: before_mean 4207 -> after_mean 1888, relative_change -0.5512; across 4 weeks each side 3196 -> 2538 (-21%); choke_before 82.84% -> 57.57%, choke_moved true. Period from 2008-02-17 to 2011-01-02.

findings.claim: F-12's bridge plug at 3 210 m on 2010-09-20 did not cut water: 60-day water cut rose from 64% to 68%.
findings.detail: Plug set 2010-09-20 depth 3210 m in blank pipe (blank_pipe_m 3180-3220). Production log 2010-09-22: below 3210 m water_share 0.325 low rate, 0.376 medium rate; oil_share 0.011, 0.015. Before 60 days water_cut 0.638 oil 1850 Sm3/d (48 days 2010-07-22 to 2010-09-20); after 60 days water_cut 0.676 oil 1612 Sm3/d (59 days 2010-09-24 to 2010-11-23). Since survey 100 days to 2010-12-31 water_cut 0.6307 -> 0.7133.

findings.claim: F-14 also needs watching: oil rate dropped 34% around 2010-01-10, weekly mean 3 616 to 2 397 Sm3/d with choke unchanged.
findings.detail: Regime change oil_rate 2010-01-10: before_mean 3616 -> after_mean 2397, relative_change -0.3369; across 2892 -> 2657 (-8%); choke 45.29% -> 45.31% choke_moved false. Water cut shift 2009-12-06: 0.0594 -> 0.53; crossed 0.5 on 2010-04-05. As of 2010-12-31 rate 2175 Sm3/d water_cut 0.6112.

findings.claim: Field voidage replacement is about 1.08 in 2010 and platform limits are not exceeded.
findings.detail: Field voidage replacement_ratio 2010 1.08 (1.03-1.13 with Bo 1.5/1.27) vs 1.11 in 2009, 0.9864 in 2008. Field vs design: max liquid 10,826 Sm3/d in 2010-06 under 13,000 limit; water_cut max 0.6715 in 2010-12 under 0.80; oil max 8,924 in 2008-12 under 9,000; water handling max 7,193 under 10,400 (13000*0.8). Injection capacity 16,000 exceeded only 3 months max 17,206 in 2008-12.

findings.claim: For F-12 the next 12 months from 2011-01-01 central estimate is about 375,000 Sm3, range 316,000 to 1.11 million Sm3, but the model fit is poor.
findings.detail: Forecast window 2010-10-01 to 2010-12-31, n 91, exponential best qi 1681 Sm3/producing day di 0.6581 per year b 0.0, r2_log 0.2177 warning poor fit <0.7. Cumulative p50 375,254 p90 342,615 p10 413,561 bootstrap; calibrated band p90 316,345 p10 1,109,266 past_forecasts 6 coverage 0.71 median_abs_error 0.2302 (band may be too narrow, 6 forecasts before window). p50_by_model exponential 375,254 harmonic 402,061. Use calibrated band not bootstrap; model disagreement modest on this window. Uptime 0.9845.

result.plan_end_quote: Kumulativ oljeproduksjon inntil minimum økonomisk rate på 2.100 Sm3 /d (gitt Volve oljepris på 18,7 USD/fat) nås er 11,4 MSm3
result.note: These are field and platform limits (PUD p.35 lists the same platform capacities); compare them with field totals, never one well. The maximum water cut is a share at full liquid rate: the water the platform can handle is liquid capacity x maximum water cut (water_sm3_per_day). The field reaching that share at a lower liquid rate means it ran at the design water cut, not over its water capacity. Rates are per calendar day of each month.

summaries.summary: Skidded rig to F-12. Made up 36" hole opener BHA and RIH with same to 85 m MD.

Built scaffolding at the well head deck and in the moon pool. Installed surface riser, BOP and tension cylinders.
Nippled up slick jnt, diverter and torqued up the BOP. RIH and installed the Bowl Protector at 20.9 m. Retrieved the Annulus Insert at 139.9 m. Retrieved the Bowl Protector.
RIH with 10 3/4" Tie Back and made up into sub sea well. Pressure tested Tie Back connector to 345 bars. Attempted to lock the Surface hanger, with the Adjustment sub.
Retrieved landing string. Installed BPV. Nippled down BOP and Riser. Installed dart in BPV. Terminated control lines. Installed extension spool.
Installed the WH extension spool, Xmas tree and the production Co-flex hose.
Leak tested X-mas tree connections to 30/345 bars 5/10 min. Lined up and leak tested production line 50/180 bars 5/10 min. Inflow tested LMV and HMV against BPV.
Sent firing command to E-Fire firing head in TCP guns and perforated well from 3130 to 3281 mMDRT.

Handed well over from Production. RU HMV and DHSV to local control panel. Installed test and bleed manifold on to XMT KWV. Performed line test from KWV to cmt unit. Attempted to leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min.

Operated and greased up leaking PWV. Leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min. Installed WL BOP and riser on XMT. Tested shear seals on WL BOP. Installed combination toolstring in riser. MU lubricator. Leak test WL riser, BOP and lubricator. Equalize and open HMV and DHSV. RIH with combination toolstring and tagged TCP guns at 3260.5 m. Performed correlation log in 7" liner. POOH and prepared for inflow test of HMV.

Inflow tested HMV to 81-5 bar/10 min. Broke lubricator and LD toolstring. Installed PLT toolstring in riser. MU lubricator and leak tested at in-situ sub. Equalized and opened HMV. RIH with PLT toolstring on 7/16" EWL from surface to 2929 m. Performed stationary logging at DHPG depth. Continued RIH from 2929 m to 3030 m to perform shut-in station logs and 4 PLT tool calibration passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Bean up well to 4500 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 high rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Choked back flow to 3000 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 medium rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD.

Choked back flow to 1500 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 low rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Shut-in well. POOH with PLT toolstring. Inflow tested DHSV, HMV and MMV for handover. BO lubricator and LD toolstring. LD lubricator. RD and LD WL riser.

RD BOP from XMT. Leak test XMT cross, KWV and tree cap. Hand well over to Mærsk Production. Cleared and cleaned rig floor of remaining WL equipment. Transferred operation to F-99 for PRS-and 5-yearly BOP classification.
Waited on access to well. Took over well. Rigged up WL riser and BOP.

RU WL equipment. Installed BHA into lubricator. RIH with PLT. Performed spinner calibration. Performed depth correlation with GR/CCL. Took stationary reading at 2929 m. Ran PLT shut in pass. Took stationary readings. Beaned up well. Waited for stable flow.

Waited for stable flow aprox. 5050 Sm3/d with PLT at 3080 m. Attempted to RIH at various speed. No-go. Reduced flow rate to 3000 Sm3/d. Took stationary readings at 3080, 3155, 3200 and 3250 m. Logged flowing passes between 3030 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Reduced flow rate to 1500 Sm3/d. Logged flowing passes between 3000 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Unable to log down on both flowing rates at 10/20/30 m/min. POOH with PLT. Changed tool string. RIH with 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 800 m.
Installed 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 3210 m mid element. RD wireline pressure control equipment and handed well over to production department.

result.note: A production log measures the flow passing each depth while the well flows; going up, it grows past each zone that produces. A share at a depth is the part of the pass's oil or water entering below that depth (1 at the bottom of the well's inflow, 0 above the top zone). comes_in_from_m to to_m holds 90% of each phase's inflow. Only shares are given: the files' rates have no units, and the plots' are downhole volumes. A plug set at a depth shuts off what enters below it: the shares below say what it could remove, not what it did; plugs_set gives what each plug already set did to the well (water cut and oil before and after). A bridge plug is set in blank pipe, never inside a perforated interval (inside_perforation_m names the interval a depth falls in; blank_pipe_m lists the gaps). since_survey says how old the latest log is and how far the water cut has moved since: an old log may no longer show where the water enters, and a new one would settle it. Each survey's passes were run at several surface rates. A survey read off pictures carries the checks of that reading.

summaries.summary: Skidded rig to F-14. Continued changing wires on aft PRS and attempted to change DCI hose, but operation postponed due to weather. Removed hatches and built scaffolding around hatches on all levels. Waited on weather for cranes to pick up CART and BHA.

WOW. Changed wash pipe. Racked CART std. MU and RIH with 36" HO BHA to 143 m. Stung into funnel assisted by ROV. Tagged sea btm and drilled 36" hole from 145.7 m to 193 m MD using SW and hi-vis pills.

Drilled 36" hole from 193 m to 204 m MD. Circulated well clean and displaced to 1.40 sg bentonite mud. POOH and LD 36" HO BHA. WOW due to no crane operation. MU and RIH with 30" conductor until x-over joint. Started to install UWG top-up system on upper 35 m.

Positioned 30" conductor at cementing depth at 196.8 m. Mixed and pumped 106 m³ 1.52 SG Tuned Light XL cement slurry. Got returns up F-7, but after 70 m3 pumped, had full returns up F-14. Displaced cement slurry with 6.5 m³ of SW. Waited on cement to set. Meanwhile performed general maintenance. LIned up for flushing of top-up line.

Pressure tested UWG top-up system using the cement unit, rupture disk burst at 53 bars (769 psi). Performed cement top-up job, pumped 10.4 m³, 1.56 SG G-cement 82 bars at 500 lpm. Released with CART tool and POOH with the landing string. Prepared for measuring the double on top of the CART tool. Laser measuring device was dropped onto the rig floor. Racked back the CART tool in derrick. Laid out the aluminium inner string. Prepared for skidding of the cantilever from F-14 to F-5.
None
Skidded rig from F-1 to F-14. Removed hatches. Broke down HWDP stand for inspection.

Started running 26" drilling BHA. ROV lost 3-finger claw in hole. Assessed situation. POOH with 26" drilling BHA. RIH with 26" junk removal BHA with rock bit. Drilled cement and rathole down to 206 m MD. POOH with 26" junk removal BHA and laid down same. Found pieces of junk in bit. Broke bit and bitsub. RIH with 26" drilling BHA from surface to 133 m MD.

Drilled 26" hole from 206 m to 211 m MD. Pulled BHA to thighten UBHO sleeve. RIH with BHA. Waited for work on Siemens system. Drilled 26" hole from 211 to 269 m MD, steered as required. Performed gyro single shot survey on each single drilled.
Continued RU csg running equipment. MU and ran 20" casing to 414 m MD.

Continued MU and ran 20" casing from 414 to 923 m MD. Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment. MU 18 3/4" WH housing/CART assembly to 20" casing. Lowered 18 3/4" WH housing/CART through well head module. Installed DCI assembly on 18 3/4" WH housing, working on scaffolding platform below WH module.
Continued installing DCI assembly on WH housing. RIH and land 20" casing. Circulate, pump and displace cement. Release CART and POOH. LD CART. Clear drill floor. Skidded rig to F-9.

Skidded cantilever to F-14. Prepared & rigged up HPDR spider and handling equipment. M/U HPDR TBC and double "A". Function tested HPDR TBC. Running of HPDR suspended. Resumed maintenance of the aft PRS.
Skidded the cantilever to F-12 and F-14 for re-arranging hatch covers. Shut down production. Re-arranged hatch covers. Ran in with TBC and HPDR double "A" and picked up HPDR double "B"
Ran in with HPDR, landed and locked the HPDR. Made up the tension system.
Landed BOP riser jnt and made up same. Performed integrity test of HPDR to 30 bars / 10 min. Commenced nippling up the BOP.
Nippled up the BOP, bell nipple and diverter. Pressure tested the well/BOP/riser to 155 bars 10 min. * Operation suspended due to programmed manitenance in derrick and PRS's.
Set nominal seat protector. Made up 17 1/2" BHA. RIH with 17 1/2" BHA and drilled 20" shoetrack.

Cleaned rathole and drilled 3 m new formation down to 1086 m MD. Pumped hi-vis sweep, displaced to 1,20 sg WBM and spotted LCM pill in rathole. Conditioned mud and performed FIT to 1,38 EMW. Drilled 17 1/2" section down to 1302 m MD. Had problems with overflow on shakers and screen plugging.
Drilled 17 1/2" hole section from 1302 m to 1725 m MD.
Perforate well with BHA #6, interval #4 on WL. Perforate well with BHA #7, interval #5 on WL.
Perforate well with BHA #8, interval #6 on WL. Inflow tested HMV and DHSV to SIWHP-5 bar. Started RD lubricator.
RD lubricator, risers and WL BOPs. Clean and clear rig floor. Leak tested tree cap, XMT cross and KWV cap. Handed over well to Mærsk production.
Re-arranged hatches on Weather deck. Skidded rig from F-15 to F-14. Waited on production to hand over well F-14.
Waited on production to hand over well F-14 (due to initial start up of F-15). Meanwhile performed general PMs and houskeeping in drilling areas. Dismantled BOP components.

Waited on handover of well f-14. Recieved well from production at 19:00. Hooked up local control panel and connected riser. Hooked up BOP control hose and calibrated BOP. Hooked up bleed off manifold and tested same. Tested XMT cross. Rigged up WL and made up toolstring. Tested WL rig up 30/200 bar 5/10 min - ok. Tested check valve for flowback - ok. Pumped MEG to equalize DHSV.

Equalised across DHSV and SV. RIH on WL to 2543 m MD. Correlated depth. Performed PLT calibration. Took stationary PLT readings as per program from 3333 m to 2950 m MD. Beaned up well to 1500 Sm3/d. Production shut down. Waited on production. Beaned up well to 1600 Sm3/d. Took stationary PLT readings as per program from 3333 m to 2950 m MD.

Made PLT logging passes from 3395 m to 2950 m MD at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Beaned up well to 3000 Sm3/d. Took PLT stationary readings. Made PLT logging passes from 3395 m to 2950 m MD at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Beaned up well to 4250 Sm3/d. Made PLT logging passes from 3395 m to 2950 m MD at 40 and 30 m/min.

Made PLT logging passes from 3395 m to 2950 m MD at 20 and 10 m/min. Took PLT stationary readings. POOH with PLT. Inflow tested HMV and SV. Purged and flushed riser. Hooked up permanent controls to XMT. Stand-by for rigging down WL until scheduled shut-in.

Stod by for rigging down WL until scheduled shut-in. Canceled cheduled production shut-in and had to wait on Mærsk to finish off 5-yearly work on tension cylinders in moonpool. Waited on Mærsk Production to shut in well and inflow test HMVand DHSV. Drained lubricator and WL riser. Broke out lubricator and LD toolstring. Tested WL BOP to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. LD lubricator. Installed double lift arrangement from TDS to WL BOP and riser.

Disconneced WL riser and BOP from XMT and suspended from rig floor. RD surface lines. Re-arranged and installed hatches on weather deck. RD surface lines and RU HP hose to XMT KWV. Leak tested XMT cross, SV, KWV and tree cap. Handed well over to Mærsk production. Skidded rig to F-12. Transferred operation to F-12.
Spotted and and hooked up WL equip. Assembled lubricator and riser. Built cable head.
Prepared WL equipment for rig-up and tested PLT and Tractor. Handed well over to well service. Rigged up lower riser and BOP.
Rigged up WL equipment. RIH with PLT/RST. Performed spinner calibration and started to bean up well to test separator with full bore spinner at 2900 m MDRKB.
Performed PLT logging as per program.
Performed RST logging in IC mode, across interval from 3642 to 2970 m.
Continued logging RST in IC mode at 0,5 m/min up to 2975 m. Started tractor and RIH to 3642 m. Logged RST in IC mode at 0,5 m/min from 3642 to 3150 m.

Logged RST from 3150 to 3101 m. RST far detector stopped working. Ran PLT logging pass from 3390 m up to 2970 m at speed 10, 20, 30 and 40 m/min. Took stationary readings at 3200, 3040 and 2970 m. Evaluated data. POOH. LD BHA. Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well and prepared 5/16" cable equipment.
Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well and prepared 5/16" cable equipment. Held SJA meeting regarding RD wireline equipment.

Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well. Received plug equipment. Closed in well. Ran EVO plug on 3 1/8" tractor. Stopped into DHSV. Started to equalize DHSV by pumping MEG into well.

Equalized and opened DHSV. RIH with 7" EVO plug. Lost communikation to BHA. POOH. RIH with back-up 7" EVO plug and tractor. Installed EVO plug with top plug at 3274,25 m. POOH. Inflow tested HMV. LD BHA. Started to bleed down pressure above DHSV.
Bled off pressure above DHSV and closed well. RD WL equipment. Installed x-mas tree top cap. Handed well back to Production Department.

Only shares are given: the files' rates have no units, and the plots' are downhole volumes. A plug set at a depth shuts off what enters below it: the shares below say what it could remove, not what it did; plugs_set gives what each plug already set did to the well (water cut and oil before and after). A bridge plug is set in blank pipe, never inside a perforated interval (inside_perforation_m names the interval a depth falls in; blank_pipe_m lists the gaps). since_survey says how old the latest log is and how far the water cut has moved since: an old log may no longer show where the water enters, and a new one would settle it. Each survey's passes were run at several surface rates. A survey read off pictures carries the checks of that reading.
